verification_method: Direct PyMuPDF text extraction of SHA256-verified archived primary PDFs, with visual inspection of pin maps, table alignments, derating curves and ambiguous source footnotes. Ledger used solely to locate archived bytes. No access to implementation, specification, decisions or prior reports.
scope_limitations: Bench-results and model correctness are outside this source-only stage.
Physical package bindings are not inferred from intrinsic manufacturer pin roles.
An empty mismatch list means the sampled source claims were supported within their stated scope, not that the part or model is fully verified.

results.notes: Fresh source-only verification: every listed field was compared with the cited primary PDF, including table headings and material notes. Sampled gapfill evidence and generated research record agree after normalization of omitted/null optional keys; embedded gapfill content hash matches. Class-bench receipts, implementation, specification, decisions, previous reports, package bindings and physical hardware were not read or verified. Their status is not inferred from this source review. Page 1 supports P70 and the temperature limit; page 6 independently corroborates the derating knee/endpoints visually. No film-to-board thermal constant was inferred.
